lateWaveMusic.production: Both scene Battle Control instances append one presentation string before FSM caches and snapshot arrays are constructed. The native Music Control StateChanged callback records actual MUSIC target events, with a revision for repeated cues. Existing string snapshots retain the last effective cue even when the present wave has no MUSIC action. Replica changes only its local audio child; native AI stays disabled. No new packet kind or network component.
